title: Create a detailed character sheet with multiple reference images using GPT-2…
content:
Create a detailed character sheet with multiple reference images using GPT-2 before generating video.  
Use the character sheet as a reference in Seedance 2.0 4K to generate an anime-style sequence where the same character stays consistent frame after frame.  
Generate with Seedance 2.0 in native 4K output to get high-resolution clips without post-production cleanup, then assemble the clips into a sequence.
